description.value: Lizard Creek Lodge is a full-service luxury mountain lodge sited slopeside at Fernie Alpine Resort, offering ski-in/ski-out and bike-in/bike-out access directly from the property. The lodge comprises 14 suites in the main building plus 85 residential-style condominiums with full kitchens, gas fireplaces, and private balconies, making it well suited to multi-night touring stays. On-site amenities include the Cirque Restaurant & Bar, the Névé Day Spa, an outdoor heated pool, and hot tubs with mountain views.

address.value: Box 6032, 5346 Highline Drive, Fernie, BC V0B 1M6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides comprehensive information about the lodge. The front desk phone (250-423-2057) matches OSM exactly, and the address 5346 Highline Drive, Fernie, BC V0B 1M6 is confirmed. The site explicitly mentions 'bike-in/bike-out access' and 'Secured Underground Parking' but contains no specific description of a dedicated bike storage room, bike procedure for touring bikes, or bike-specific amenities; Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed as complimentary in every room and the on-site Cirque Restaurant serves dinner daily.
concerns: OSM address omits city, province, and postal code; full address from website is 'Box 6032, 5346 Highline Drive, Fernie, BC V0B 1M6'. OSM phone (+1-250-423-2057) matches the front desk number on the website; lodge also lists a separate toll-free reservations line (1-877-228-1948) not in OSM.
Website mentions bike-in/bike-out access but provides no detail on secure overnight bike storage arrangements — this warrants direct follow-up with the lodge.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating full-service lodge at Fernie Alpine Resort with active reservations, on-site dining, and confirmed bike-in/bike-out access — clearly useful to touring cyclists.
